name: Overheat Warning
description: Component temperature exceeded safe operating threshold.

name: Pressure Drop
description: System pressure fell below minimum operating level.

name: Vibration Anomaly
description: Abnormal vibration detected; possible misalignment or imbalance.

name: Lubrication Failure
description: Insufficient lubrication detected in rotating components.

name: Coolant Leak
description: Coolant loss detected; risk of thermal runaway.

name: Power Fluctuation
description: Voltage or current instability detected in supply line.

name: Conveyor Jam
description: Conveyor belt stalled or speed below threshold.

name: Bearing Wear
description: Bearing degradation detected via vibration or temperature signature.

name: Corrosion Alert
description: Surface corrosion identified; structural integrity may be compromised.
